name: DHCP-Netboot
description: This Docker container lets you PXE boot a bunch of installers and utilities on your local network, without much mucking about configuring DHCP and TFTP servers, using the excellent netboot.xyz project.

variables.name: DHCP Range Start
variables.description: Start of the DHCP range for PXE booting. This should be in the same subnet as your Unraid server.
